hooks.command: echo '🚀 Fullstack Dev Harness' && echo '─────────────────────────' && echo '📱 Flutter: '$(flutter --version 2>&1 | head -1 || echo 'N/A') && echo '🟢 Node: '$(node --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A') && echo '🔍 브랜치: '$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A') && echo '📝 마지막 커밋: '$(git log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A') && echo '📋 TODO/FIXME: '$(grep -rn 'TODO\|FIXME\|HACK' client/ server/src/ cms/app/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')'건'

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$CMD" ] && exit 0; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|sudo|flutter build release|drop table|delete from|push --force|push -f |reset --hard|--no-verify|prisma migrate reset|prisma db push'; then echo '🚫 BLOCKED: 위험한 명령어 감지' >&2; exit 1; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$staged" ]; then secrets=$(git diff --cached -U0 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{48}|api_key\s*=|secret_key\s*=|password\s*=' | head -5); if [ -n "$secrets" ]; then echo '🚫 BLOCKED: staged 파일에 시크릿/API 키 패턴 감지' >&2; echo "$secrets" >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git commit.*-[a-zA-Z]*a[a-zA-Z]*m|^git commit.*-am|git add[[:space:]]+-A.*git commit|git add[[:space:]]+\..*git commit'; then echo '🚫 BLOCKED: -A / -am 한 방 커밋 금지. 파일/관심사별 stage 후 분리 커밋. git-workflow.md 참조' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then MSG=$(echo "$CMD" | sed -nE 's/.*-m[[:space:]]+"([^"]+)".*/\1/p; s/.*-m[[:space:]]+'\''([^'\'']+)'\''.*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$MSG" ]; then if ! echo "$MSG" | grep -qE '^(feat|fix|refactor|docs|test|chore|hotfix|style|perf|build|ci)(\([a-z,\-]+\))?:[[:space:]].+'; then echo '🚫 BLOCKED: 커밋 메시지가 Conventional Commits 형식을 안 따름. 형식: type(scope): subject. 예: feat(server): 로그인 API 추가' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$'; then echo '🚫 BLOCKED: 코드젠 파일 직접 수정 금지' >&2; exit 1; fi; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'prisma/migrations/'; then echo '🚫 BLOCKED: 마이그레이션 파일 직접 수정 금지' >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.dart$' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$'; then dart format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
echo '✅ Prisma 마이그레이션 완료 — npx prisma generate 자동 실행됨'

changed_dart=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M 2>/dev/null | grep '\.dart$' | grep -vE '\.g\.dart$|\.freezed\.dart$' | head -20); changed_ts=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M 2>/dev/null | grep '\.tsx\?$' | head -20); if [ -n "$changed_dart" ]; then echo "$changed_dart" | xargs dart format 2>/dev/null; flutter analyze --no-pub client/ 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; if [ -n "$changed_ts" ] && [ -d server ]; then cd server && npx eslint --fix $(echo "$changed_ts" | tr '\n' ' ') 2>/dev/null; cd ..; fi
osascript -e 'display notification "작업 완료" with title "Fullstack Dev" sound name "Glass"' 2>/dev/null || true

MSG=$(jq -r '.message // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE 'error|fail|exception'; then osascript -e 'display notification "에러 발생" with title "Fullstack Dev" sound name "Basso"' 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
